mode: Independent read-only source accessibility and focus review; no browser execution and no application edits

findings.location: main.ts createDependentParentLifecycle refresh: board repaint -> commitReferences -> disconnected-focus recovery
findings.trigger: Initial registry-close parent read waits. User moves keyboard focus onto a Unit board card action. Primary monthly GET succeeds, optional fallback GET fails. r2 stages that optional rejection as a throwing commit.
findings.mechanism: refreshUnitBoardReadback replaces card-grid contents and removes the focused action. commitReferences then throws before the disconnected-parent-focus recovery branch. catch only explicitly recovers focus for initiator === retry, which does not hold for the initial close refresh. Focus can remain on body.
findings.recommendation: Execute the existing owned, disconnected-parent-focus recovery before invoking the potentially throwing optional commit, or provide an equivalent guarded recovery in a shared finally path. Preserve any newer connected focus target and owner/latest-read guards.
findings.requested_test: Delayed optional fallback GET failure with successful primary read and deliberate newer focus on an actual Unit board action; assert action removal does not leave focus on body. Also assert connected fallback/select/filter focus is not stolen.

positive_source_observations: Reference update retains existing details/select/action nodes. It changes heading text, list accessible names, item text and action aria-labels without replacing owner rows.
Owner aria-label now derives currentName both on repaint and in-place refresh, correcting the stale original row.unit_name label path.
Option refresh captures selected value and retains an unavailable selected value as a disabled option. Add remains disabled until a returned available option is selected.
Select and Add disabled states include the saving set; reference refresh does not re-enable controls for an in-flight owner save.
Draft and saved ID orders remain intact. Missing owners and referenced targets receive explicit last-known unavailable labels and a role=status notice.
New owner rows are appended from the complete fallback GET; populated initial-empty state removes its obsolete No units yet paragraph.
New DOM labels use textContent, createTextNode, setAttribute or new Option; markup fields use esc and selector interpolations use CSS.escape. No new unsafe HTML label interpolation was identified.
Registry accepted mutation notification precedes its own readback. Final close notification is idempotent; dirty or busy explicit close refusals do not notify.

Owner/account/month/route/render/latest-read checks precede committed primary and reference presentation changes. Optional GET failure now permits the primary board readback to render before a truthful retry notice.
runtime_checks_still_required: Retained select focus and value after rename, removal and reintroduction of its chosen option across supported engines.
Optional fallback read rejection after delayed primary repaint, including newer keyboard focus as described in finding.
Missing owner/target label and action behavior without draft ID deletion; busy owner save interleaved with readback.
New owner with empty and nonempty confirmed fallback list; originally empty component; escaped label text.
Final close, native close, canceled dirty close, multiple accepted saves, owner supersession and GET-only retry.
limitations: Source reasoning does not establish cross-browser focus behavior or native assistive-technology announcements.
No whole original159 acceptance or broader 260-item completion follows from this review.
Existing fallback Save uncertainty copy and baseline repaint focus behavior are outside this candidate delta and are not certified by this review.
